top_deficiency_types.title: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure each resident must receive and the facility must provide necessary behavioral health care and services.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Have an enclosure around a vertical opening shaft.
Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Ensure residents have reasonable access to and privacy in their use of communication methods.
Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.
Safeguard resident-identifiable information and/or maintain medical records on each resident that are in accordance with accepted professional standards.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
